heading: An on demand car app with multi-dimensional use cases

items.title: User Profile
items.text: Every user who downloads the app can create a user profile with a personalized name and personal details.

items.title: Address
items.text: Create custom addresses, favorite locations on the built-in map for easier finding of car wash services.

items.title: Car Details
items.text: Enter car details like make, model name, year, color and other details to pick the right car wash service.

items.title: Book a wash
items.text: Users can book a car wash from their real-time location. The booking can be made for immediate use or schedule it for later.

items.title: Prefered Date and Time
items.text: Set preferred data and time in advance for car wash services. Helps plan for recurring services proactively.

items.title: Cancel Request
items.text: Users can cancel already placed car wash requests. The requests can be postponed to a later date or right away canceled.

items.title: Notification
items.text: Every booking made, accepted or rejected will be intimated to the user through push notifications.

items.title: Payment Summary
items.text: Users can get immediate payment summary for the services received.

items.title: Wallet
items.text: Payment for services offered can be made from within the mobile app with integrated digital wallets.

items.title: Multiple Payment
items.text: Notification for every successful cab booking, the arrival of a cab, ride cancellation, ride completion, offer alerts and so on.

items.title: My Washes
items.text: Users can view the timeline of all car washes that they have carried out since installing the app.

items.title: Wash Status
items.text: Get a real-time update of the car’s wash status - done, in progress, in queue, etc. through the app.

items.title: Special instruction
items.text: Users can instruct the washer to wash the car using specific washing materials, in specific routines and so on for the desired outcome.

items.title: Ratings and reviews
items.text: All services provided by the washer can be rated and reviewed with the built-in rating and review system.

items.title: Wash history
items.text: The user gets a wash history of all of its cars. This gives customers to keep better track of car wash and book next wash.

items.title: Multilingual
items.text: The app is a truly global app and can be used by any users, washers and admins from varying language backgrounds.

items.title: Help & support
items.text: For all kinds of troubleshooting and issues while using the app, help and support can be accessed from within the app itself.

items.title: Invite friends
items.text: Users can invite their friends to use the app and gain loyalty points or offers therein.

items.title: Washer Profile
items.text: Washers can create their own profiles complete with range of services offered, timing, special services offered and so on.

items.title: Add Location
items.text: Washers can add multiple locations to their services to help customers find on demand car wash services easily from their real-time location.

items.title: Wash request
items.text: Admins sends washer new wash request in its region. The washer can either accept or decline the request.

items.title: Upcoming washes
items.text: A bird’s eye view of upcoming washes, special requests from customers, estimated earnings from each wash and so on.

items.title: Wash Status
items.text: Real-time status of the wash can be updated by the user so that the user stays in loop of the estimated time of delivery of the washed car.

items.title: Notifications
items.text: The washer will receive a notification for the new car wash request sent by the admin.

items.title: Before and after photo
items.text: Washers can prove their efficiency in delivering wash services by adding the before and after wash photo of the cars.

items.title: Key request
items.text: On the scheduled time, the washer can reach the car owners place and within the app, they can request a car key.

items.title: Payment request
items.text: Once the wash is completed, the washer can request for the payment to the admin. He can request payment for multiple services.

items.title: Ratings and reviews
items.text: Washers can leave reviews and ratings for the customers to point out best customers and the unruly lot.

items.title: Washer registration
items.text: Admin has the control to accept or reject a washer registration request in the app backend.

items.title: User registration
items.text: Admin can moderate users by checking their profiles, social media handles and so on.

items.title: Car wash request
items.text: Manage car wash requests proactively by giving high priority to idle washers.

items.title: Washer approved payout
items.text: Admins can check reviews and ratings, terms of service and so on before approving payout to the washer.

items.title: Washer pending payout
items.text: A quick view of the payments pending to washers, wash transactions and overdue duration can be seen.

items.title: Create plans
items.text: Admins can create specific pricing plans based on the nature of services offered, duration of the plan, location and so on.

items.title: Create a car category
items.text: Admins can create a template or readymade list of car categories that users and washers can pick from for services.

items.title: Car wash history
items.text: For verifying payouts, service frequency and for your measuring efficiency, the admin can look up car wash history from the dashboard.

items.title: Email and SMS notification
items.text: Admins can configure email settings for firing email and SMS notification for every major action carried out using the app.

items.title: Washer payout
items.text: Upon receiving the payment request from the washer, Admin verifies the services and releases payment to the washers bank account.

items.title: Manage ratings & feedback
items.text: Admin can moderate the star rating and reviews given by users and control any malicious activity, if needed.
